task: Add truncation detection to terminal LangGraph messages, expose finish_reason/truncated on workflow state output API, and confirm LiteLLM max_tokens forwarding.

component_scope.label: XL
component_scope.affected: LangGraphAgent, TaskResult (assistant_agent), LangGraphEventAdapter, WorkflowStateEvent (chains/base), BaseWorkflowExecutionState+WorkflowExecutionStateOutput (workflow_execution model), WorkflowExecutionService, BaseNode, workflow_executions REST router

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: threading.Lock non-blocking acquire pattern added to invoke_task; multi-provider LLM finish-reason format differences handled (OpenAI length/max_tokens vs Anthropic max_tokens vs Bedrock stopReason); optional fields propagated through 5 layers must be consistently nullable in DB and API
technical_risk.mitigation: Fail-open pattern: _detect_terminal_truncation catches all exceptions and logs without raising; Lock released in finally block; DB migration adds nullable columns with safe defaults; existing _get_truncation_indicator reused to avoid duplicating provider-format logic

Schema migration present.

Eight existing production files modified plus four new files (one Alembic migration + three test files: test_langgraph_truncation.py, test_base_node_truncation.py, LiteLLM confirmatory test), spanning nine directories across five subsystems.
